quirks.summary: The advanced search was exercised successfully in a national survey; document retrieval has NOT been tested at this authority.
quirks.detail: Survey outcome 'partial' on 2026-08-30: the Idox advanced search returned results and the portal behaves as Recipe C expects. That survey was metadata-only and downloaded no documents, so the documents tab, any external DMS, and the file-GET gating are all unverified here. Treat status 'untested' as meaning exactly that.
quirks.workaround: Run the documents and download steps of Recipe C and record the result before relying on this authority.

quirks.summary: WAF signals present (cloudflare) but the landing page served normally.
quirks.detail: Passive at survey time. Not a reason to avoid the automated route; it is a reason to pace properly and to expect a challenge if you do not.

quirks.summary: The advanced search offers no 'application received' date filter; use date(applicationValidatedStart/End) instead.
quirks.detail: Posting date(applicationReceivedStart) to an install that does not offer it returns HTTP 500, which reads as a portal fault rather than a bad parameter. Fields present: appealDecision, applicationDecision, applicationValidated.
quirks.workaround: Read the date field names off the advanced search form before posting.
